responsibility: Defines the DFA instruction scheduling model for the embedded IBM 403/405-class PowerPC cores in the rs6000 backend. It describes the available execution units and issue behavior for these processors and assigns latencies/reservations to GCC instruction types such as loads, stores, integer ALU ops, compares, multiply/divide, CR operations, branches, and 405 floating-point operations, so the scheduler can order RTL instructions appropriately when tuning for ppc403 or ppc405.
